scope.summary: Implement the simulate_garment MCP tool (canonical wire name per Master Spec 13.13.4; supersedes the run_simulation working name): trigger a sandboxed sim job for a draft garment and deliver the typed SimulationReceipt as MCP structuredContent per TAI-OVR-005.
acceptance_criteria: Tool is registered under the canonical MCP wire name simulate_garment (13.13.4); no run_simulation tool name is exposed.
Tool dispatches a Handshake job (scheduler leases/cancellation apply), returning the SIM- run id; dispatch is non-thread-blocking.

The typed SimulationReceipt (hsk.tailor.simulation_receipt@1) is returned to the model as MCP structuredContent when the run completes, per TAI-OVR-005; receipt fetch is NOT a separate tool (get_garment also exposes the latest receipt).
scope.risk_if_missed: A blocking sim tool stalls the swarm; a non-canonical tool name (run_simulation) produces tool-not-found failures in model prompts and ModelManual drift against spec 13.13.4.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
